text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels in January.
Nejmat El Petrol XXIV - (built 1975) 89,500 dwt sold for $143 plt asis in Fujairah/Rabigh Bay and onsold to Pakistan for $168 plt.
Meric - (built 1970) 10,350 dwt sold for $162 plt for delivery Calcutta, India.
Syzran - (built 1968) 12,870 dwt sold for $167 plt for delivery India.
Long Tian - (built 1966) 12,991 dwt sold for $162 plt for delivery Calcutta, India.
Vasiliy Klochkov - (built 1974) 13,500 dwt sold for $160 plt for delivery India.
Aleksandr Tsyurupa - (built 1970) 13,738 dwt sold for $158 plt for delivery Karachi/Bangladesh options.
Arkadiy Gaydar - (built 1965) 14,170 dwt sold for $158 plt for delivery India.
Nazym Khikmet - (built 1965) 14,170 dwt sold for $156 plt for delivery Bangladesh.
Dalia - (built 1972) 15,144 dwt sold for $154 plt for delivery India.
Mun Su Bong - (built 1969) 15,177 dwt sold for $156 plt for delivery India.
Jupiter 1 - (built 1969) 15,418 dwt sold for $156 plt for delivery Bangladesh on subject basis.
Mana Eleni - (built 1972) 15,550 dwt sold for $158.50 plt for delivery Calcutta, India.
Kapitan Anistratenko - (built 1973) 16,618 dwt sold for $161.50 plt for delivery Bangladesh.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to survey, inspection or other conditions.
